content: The use of a MLP was motivated by the observation that for graph classification, MP neural nets with 1-layer perceptrons are inferior to their MLP counterparts BIBREF14. Indeed, 1-layer perceptrons are not universal approximators of multiset functions. Note that like in BIBREF14, we use a different MLP at each layer.
